observations: Photo 0 shows a sewing machine head/arm with a visible marking that looks like "EM81" on the red/black area.
The machine appears to be an industrial-style sewing machine (heavy-duty head), but only a close-up of the head/label area is shown.
No clear view of the motor, belt/drive system, needle area, stitch controls, or any working demonstration.

claims.claim: Direct drive emel industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show the drive system (motor/belt/direct coupling) clearly enough to confirm direct drive.

risks.risk: Drive type may not be direct drive (could be belt-driven or missing/incorrect motor setup).
risks.proof: A photo showing the motor connection and the drive coupling/belt path (or a short video starting the machine and showing motion).
risks.if_unproven: Price as industrial sewing machine with unknown drive/untested setup (worst case: not confirmed direct drive).

risks.risk: Machine may be non-functional or needs servicing (timing, feed, needle bar, tension issues).
risks.proof: Short video sewing a straight line on fabric with needle/tension visible, plus a close-up of the bobbin area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/needs service until proven.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, motor, table, power cable).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out, and a checklist of included parts (motor/table/bobbins/feet).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing (worst case: machine head only).

risks.risk: Model/brand identification may be wrong (label could be partial or swapped).
risks.proof: Photo of the full nameplate/model plate on the machine body and any serial number sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price using the lowest-confidence industrial sewing machine category for the shown head.

proof_requests: Photo of the full machine (front + side) showing the motor/drive connection to confirm direct drive.
Video of it running and sewing (straight stitch) with fabric and needle/tension visible.
Close-up photos of bobbin area, feed mechanism, and tension dial.
Photo of the nameplate/serial/model plate (clear and readable).
List and photos of included accessories (motor, table, foot pedal, bobbins, presser feet, needles, power cable).
response.reason: The photo only shows a partial head/label area (appears to read EM81), but it does not confirm direct drive or working condition. Without drive confirmation and a working test, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
